_comment: Pipeline routing config. tool_labels: label -> {tool name, spoken name for clarification questions, whether to resolve a place from the utterance}. Every other label in labels.json needs a prompt policy in llm_labels. Confidence gate for a TOOL top class (calibrated confidence c): c >= tau_hi -> execute; tau_lo <= c < tau_hi -> ask the injectable arbiter (top-3 classes + 'none'): same class as the router -> execute, anything else (or no arbiter, or an arbiter error) -> deterministic clarification, never a tool; c < tau_lo -> LLM clarify policy. The arbiter can only confirm the router's class, never choose another. Non-tool top classes route to the LLM with their prompt policy when c >= tau_lo.

llm_labels.call_llm: answer_question: answer the space/science question concisely and accurately for an astronaut mid-task.
llm_labels.NO_TOOL: chitchat: reply briefly and warmly; no tools are needed.
llm_labels.OOD: out_of_scope: politely say this is out of scope for Nova and offer help with mission, suit, navigation or space questions.

low_confidence_policy: clarify: the request was unclear; ask one short clarifying question and do not guess a tool.
clarify_question: I'm not sure I understood. Did you want {options}?
